description: Leon Sandler publishes LAND-MAP, a Python simulation of sensor selection and excavation decisions for landfill mining. The September 2026 ZIP and GitHub source are free under MIT. The model generates synthetic material fields, combines magnetic, electromagnetic, radar, thermal and gas signals, and links classifiers to a value-of-information calculation. Its scripts vary site composition, sensor degradation and economic assumptions. They can support methodological simulation experiments comparing classification accuracy with economic decision value. The provider explicitly states that no field, laboratory or testbed measurements validate the model. Every response coefficient and performance result is therefore conditional on assumed synthetic conditions, not demonstrated landfill performance. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. The README was inspected, while scripts, numerical outputs and submitted manuscript were not executed or downloaded.
